name: Can I use chemical drain cleaners for a laundry drain clog?

mainEntity.name: Can I use chemical drain cleaners for a laundry drain clog?

acceptedAnswer.text: We generally advise against using chemical drain cleaners for laundry clogs. While they may offer a temporary fix, these harsh chemicals can corrode pipes over time, especially older ones, and may not fully clear stubborn blockages. For effective and safe clog removal, especially with more severe blockages, professional drain cleaning methods like hydro-jetting or snaking are more appropriate. This approach protects your plumbing infrastructure and provides a lasting solution.
acceptedAnswer.description: Chemical drain cleaners are not recommended for laundry clogs as they can damage pipes and may not fully clear blockages.
